bio: In this centrally located family-run property, which has close ties with the soil and has been in business for over 25 years, the focus is on traditional cuisine with a contemporary twist, an honest approach and locally sourced seasonal ingredients. The cuisine is centred on two menus, one daily version, the second a tasting option – on the latter guests can choose a main dish from a list of different options. We can highly recommend the braised veal cheek with port wine....
